categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in manufacturing micro switches and switching power supplies. It also engages in producing industrial plastic products, ceramics, metal products, powder metallurgy, machinery equipment, electrical and electronic products, communication equipment, computer peripherals, molds, and international trade. Additionally, it operates parking lot management services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes research and development in waterproof switches, high-temperature and high-current switches, automotive-related switches, and modular switch assemblies. It integrates AC/DC and DC/DC power supply solutions with a focus on high power output and density, employing automated production processes and digitalized flexible manufacturing to enhance efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial computer manufacturers, communication equipment producers, storage system providers, medical device companies, network and cloud computing data centers, consumer electronics, industrial equipment, and automotive sectors. The company targets niche markets requiring customized, small-batch production with short lead times.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company sources raw materials globally, including Japan, the USA, South Korea, China, Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, and the Netherlands. It serves international markets with a focus on global engineering design services and brand development, particularly in emerging countries and regions requiring specialized power supply products.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, manufacturing finished and semi-finished micro switches and power supplies. It sources raw materials and components such as semiconductors, capacitors, transformers, and printed circuit boards from upstream suppliers and delivers products to system assemblers and end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maintaining technological leadership through consistent R&D investment (~3% of revenue), developing waterproof and high-current switches, automotive applications, and modular products. The company focuses on product miniaturization, automation, digitalization of manufacturing, and expanding into medical, military, automation, network security, and power battery markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of micro switches and switching power supplies, including finished goods and semi-finished products. The company also engages in international trade and provides customized solutions to meet specific customer needs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a technology leader with diversified product lines and a strong focus on niche markets requiring customization and high-quality engineering. It leverages brand recognition (ZIPPY) and global engineering services to differentiate from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported net sales of approximately NT$2.24 billion in the latest fiscal year, with micro switches accounting for 53.86% and switching power supplies 46.14% of sales. R&D expenses consistently represent about 3% of revenue, indicating steady investment in innovation. The company maintains stable operations supported by diversified product lines and global sourcing.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product customization, high reliability, and technological innovation, particularly in waterproof and automotive switches and flexible power supply solutions. It offers integrated AC/DC and DC/DC designs with high power density and automated manufacturing to ensure quality and competitive pricing. The focus on digitalized production and customer-specific modules enhances responsiveness to market demands.
